text: Execution order: start with typed FitInterpreter spine, reusable ChunkProgram reducers, and ResponsePreparationPlan. Then land robust/GLS/latent engines against that spine. Follow with typed result bundles, analysis/job/preflight DSL, group/meta extension, and only then the optional JVM/app plugin catalog. The epic is blocked by all child slices; downstream slices are also blocked by their architectural prerequisites.
